title: ARC dataset v1.1: per-service damage of remediation actions in two microservice systems
description: 2,075 controlled incidents on two open-source microservice systems, Train Ticket (1,795 episodes, 20 to 25 services) and Online Boutique (280 episodes, 11 services), on Kubernetes with Chaos Mesh faults. In each, one remediation action (no-op, restart-pod, rollout-restart, scale-up, cpu-bump, drain) is applied and the damage to every service is measured as the rise of its share of bad requests. Raw telemetry (per-service time series, call graph, exact counters, every user request), labels at three latency bars, nine evaluation splits, calibration, a loader and a datasheet. Known issues (saturation, one machine, short bursts) are listed in DATASHEET.md.
